title: State of Jharkhand v. Shailendra Kumar Rai

content.caseIdentity: State of Jharkhand v. Shailendra Kumar Rai, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1494
content.holding: Reiterated the absolute ban on the regressive and traumatizing "two-finger test" (per vaginum examination) on rape survivors, holding that a woman’s sexual history has no bearing on whether she gave consent, and directing that conducting the test constitutes criminal misconduct.
